specification.description: Smart burgundy flat sandals with clean leather straps and a low-profile travel-ready shape. Standard fit with a softly finished footbed and practical fastening.
construction_details: Smooth leather upper with joined forefoot straps
Cushioned footbed with neatly stitched edge
Adjustable ankle buckle and flexible rubber outsole
specification.care_instructions: Wipe gently with a soft, slightly damp cloth and condition the leather occasionally. Air dry away from direct heat.
